import json,sys,copy,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/national')
from assemble import assemble,read_json
from research_common import decode_tile,rounded_coordinate
root=Path('.').resolve();m=read_json(root/'tools/national/manifest.json');before,a=assemble(root,m)
N=Path('data/national/kanto-prefecture/ibaraki');E=Path('data/evidence/kanto-prefecture/ibaraki')
sel=read_json(N/'selection.json');ps={p['id']:p for p in before['places']};ids=set(sel['facilityIds']);assert len(ids)==18
assert {p['id'] for p in before['places'] if p['address'].startswith('茨城') and not p.get('coordinate')}==ids
assert {r['placeId'] for r in before['relations'] if r['cardId'].startswith('08-') and not ps[r['placeId']].get('coordinate')}==ids
assert a['inputSHA256']==sel['inputSHA256'];assert hashlib.sha256(Path('tools/national/manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sel['manifestSHA256']
for row in read_json(E/'history.json')['facilities']:
 for h in row['resolvedHistory']:
  path,_,ptr=h['ref'].partition('#');raw=Path(path).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==h['sha256']
  if ptr:
   v=json.loads(raw)
   for k in ptr.strip('/').split('/'):v=v[int(k)] if isinstance(v,list) else v[k]
 for r in row['verifiedOriginals']:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(r['snapshotPath']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['snapshotSHA256']
for r in read_json(E/'vector-window.json')['tiles']:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(r['retainedPath']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
g=read_json(E/'moriya-geometry.json');raw=(E/'16-58249-25746.pbf.gz').read_bytes();geom=decode_tile(raw)['BldA']['features'][g['featureIndex']]['geometry'];assert geom==g['geometry'];assert rounded_coordinate(geom,g['tile'],g['selectedTileXY'])==g['calculation']
p=read_json(N/'manifest-selection-proposed.json');m['locations']+=p['locations'];m['locationLifecycle']+=p['locationLifecycle'];after,b=assemble(root,m)
changed=[x['id'] for x,y in zip(before['places'],after['places']) if x!=y];assert changed==[g['facilityId']];assert before['relations']==after['relations'];assert len(before['places'])==len(after['places'])==1586
assert sum(not p.get('coordinate') for p in before['places'])==588
print('PASS: 18 target IDs, all inherited refs/source hashes, 9 retained tiles, raw geometry and rounded containment')
print('PASS: proposed schema/binding/selection; only Moriya place differs; all 1670 relations unchanged; actual manifest remains 588 unlocated')
